1622: ## MIG-1 proof factoring proposed in #233 (2026-11-07)
1623: 
1624: **Proposed, not retired on the campaign branch; gate118 open.** The partial fill and subsequent
1625: maintainer review identify the following kinds, with canonical reuse implemented in draft#233:
1626: input/work-buffer rewind variants; selected/unselected bank and phase frames; buffer replay;
1627: split-orbit/erase/embedding variants; startup-plus-halted-segment computation certificates;
1628: clean-bank boundary reconstruction; canonical tape-update/clipping and framed increment
1629: endpoints; projection-space corollaries; and unrestricted equal-time tagged-step propagation.
1630: The last uses Mathlib's existing invariant iterator, with no new public host/API/import.
1631: 
1632: Canonical statements, exact remaining scope and references to each tested implementation are
1633: in `campaign/fills/mig1/landing/factoring-dispositions-final.md`. Full source-inclusive screens
1634: retain every new and weighted-existing candidate, including data matches and let-header parser
1635: limits. This is bounded candidate enumeration plus inspection, not a global optimality claim.
1636: The two superseded private selector helpers are removed once the whole bank reconstruction
1637: uses its existing shared equation. Short constructor/field-reader packages already call the
1638: canonical API; their remaining source similarity is disclosed rather than converted into a
1639: new blanket exception.

35:    maintainer has acknowledged a debt family and named its resolution, a later
36:    correction to that family's *accounting* is reported at **minor**, not major.

38:    the screen. Such a correction does not change what was approved. It is a
